{{Quote|Lake?''"<br />"''No, that is Zoma Gawanga, the Western Ocean.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Veratil]]|<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>}}
'''Zoma Gawanga''', literally "Western Ocean" in [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]], was an [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] on [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]]. [[Peace City|Colony One]], [[Colony Two]], and [[Colony Three]] were built on its shore.
